transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, a clinical conversational agent. I conducted your post-cataract surgery follow-up check and I'm here to answer any questions you may have about your recovery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi, yes, I do have a few questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: After surgery, it's recommended to avoid strenuous exercise, lifting heavy objects, and activities that may get water in your eyes for a month. However, you can start with light exercise like brisk walking, gardening, or gentle cycling after 1 week. Just be gentle with yourself and avoid anything too strenuous. Would you like to know anything else about your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should start using your preservative-free eye drops for dry eyes four times daily, as recommended by your doctor. If you're running low, your GP can provide you with more. transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
